fever_clock.seed_exchange_status: Planning budget covering the measured range (91..98F) and the derived no-fling maximum 93F (transition_structure); not a proven upper bound because leftover fling lifetime is not modelled; includes seed replacement and next operation.

fever_clock.scope: Observed Steam Fever-mode chains, input route and unknown next-seed geometry are estimates; no character-specific timing adjustment.

transition_structure.source: fever-simulator data/phase_timing.json (Steam 15209927 read-only phase capture routing-entry-20261009.jsonl, sha256 661ff59e6a7c2a8e) and code analysis in docs/TIMING.md; data/spawn_oracle.json (original seed spawn routine, 52 seeds at Fever speed 1.31)
transition_structure.status: derived_structure_one_capture_session; normal all-clear exchange and no-drop exit are code-derived without capture
transition_structure.control_tail: field phase 0 (1F) + piece spawn wait mode_phase1 (11F) after a spawn or garbage motion
transition_structure.entry: E+16 mode switch and clock start, E+37 seed spawn, +M seed motion, +12 control tail (captured M=63: 112F; 52 seeds M=41..69: 90..118F)
transition_structure.exit: E+16 back to normal, E+33 held nuisance drop check, +garbage motion, +12 (30 puyos: motion 72F, ready E+117 as captured); no drop: 45F
transition_structure.fever_exchange: max(leftover fling lifetime, field wait ~12F) + M (speed 1.31) + 12 (captured M=56: 80F)
transition_structure.ama_use: chain_ready_frames keeps the 100F budget (fever_clock.seed_exchange_estimate_frames): it covers the derived no-fling maximum 93F and measured 91..98F; fling lifetime depends on the player RNG and is not modelled
